newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers MW firm peak power at $12-13/MWh Tues.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers MW firm peak power at $12-13/MWh Tues.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered up to 300 megawatts of firm power during peak demand hours on Tuesday, the agency said Monday.
The power was priced at $12.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $13.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Tuesday firm off-peak prices were lowered to $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries, compared with $10.50 for Monday.
BPA also offered up to 300 MW of next-day, non-firm power during morning and evening peaks (hours ending 0800-1000 and 1800-2000 PST) at $16.00 for Northwest and $17.00 for COB.
Non-firm power prices for off-peak (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) and shoulder hours (1100-1700 and 2100-2200) were lowered $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Tuesday at $7.00 per MWh.
